segments.mn134:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn134:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo [lomasakakaṅgiyo (ṭīkā)] sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.mn134:2.1: Atha kho candano devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yenāyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho candano devaputto āyasmantaṃ lomasakaṅgiyaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn134:2.3: “Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn134:2.4: Tvaṃ panāvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcā”ti?
segments.mn134:2.5: “Ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn134:2.6: Dhāresi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthā”ti?
segments.mn134:2.7: “Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
segments.mn134:2.10: “Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā”ti?
segments.mn134:2.11: “Ekamidaṃ, bhikkhu, samayaṃ bhagavā devesu tāvatiṃsesu viharati pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ.
segments.mn134:2.12: Tatra bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsi –
segments.mn134:3.11: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn134:3.15: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn134:4.1: “Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhu, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
segments.mn134:4.2: Uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn134:4.3: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn134:4.4: dhārehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn134:4.5: Atthasaṃhito, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyako”ti.
segments.mn134:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo tassā rattiyā accayena senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaramādāya yena sāvatthi tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
segments.mn134:5.2: Anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn134:5.3: “Ekamidāhaṃ, bhante, samayaṃ sakkesu viharāmi kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
segments.mn134:5.4: Atha kho, bhante, aññataro devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ nigrodhārāmaṃ obhāsetvā yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho, bhante, so devaputto maṃ etadavoca –
segments.mn134:5.6: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ, bhante, taṃ devaputtaṃ etadavocaṃ –
segments.mn134:5.7: ‘na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn134:5.8: Tvaṃ panāvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañcā’ti?
segments.mn134:5.9: ‘Ahampi kho, bhikkhu, na dhāremi bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn134:5.10: Dhāresi pana tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattiyo gāthā’ti?
segments.mn134:5.11: ‘Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
segments.mn134:5.14: ‘Yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ, āvuso, dhāresi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā’ti?
segments.mn134:5.15: Ekamidaṃ, bhikkhu, samayaṃ bhagavā devesu tāvatiṃsesu viharati pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ.
segments.mn134:5.16: Tatra kho bhagavā devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsi –
segments.mn134:5.19: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn134:5.21: “Evaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhu, dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā.
segments.mn134:5.22: Uggaṇhāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn134:5.23: pariyāpuṇāhi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca;
segments.mn134:5.24: dhārehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca.
segments.mn134:5.25: Atthasaṃhito, bhikkhu, bhaddekarattassa uddeso ca vibhaṅgo ca ādibrahmacariyako’ti.
segments.mn134:5.28: Sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca desetū”ti.
segments.mn134:6.2: “Na kho ahaṃ, bhante, jānāmi taṃ devaputtan”ti.
segments.mn134:6.4: Candano, bhikkhu, devaputto aṭṭhiṃ katvā [aṭṭhikatvā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] manasikatvā sabbacetasā [sabbaṃ cetaso (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.), sabbaṃ cetasā (ka.)] samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti.
segments.mn134:6.5: Tena hi, bhikkhu, suṇāhi, sādhukaṃ manasi karohi; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn134:6.6: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo bhagavato paccassosi.
segments.mn134:7.11: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā;
segments.mn134:7.15: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate muni”.
segments.mn134:8-13.1: “Kathañca, bhikkhu, atītaṃ anvāgameti … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, atītaṃ anvāgameti.
segments.mn134:8-13.3: Kathañca, bhikkhu, atītaṃ nānvāgameti … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, atītaṃ nānvāgameti.
segments.mn134:8-13.5: Kathañca, bhikkhu, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn134:8-13.7: Kathañca, bhikkhu, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati.
segments.mn134:8-13.9: Kathañca, bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
segments.mn134:8-13.11: Kathañca, bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati … pe … evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
segments.mn134:14.11: Na hi no saṅgaraṃ tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.mn134:14.15: Taṃ ve bhaddekarattoti, santo ācikkhate munī”ti.
segments.mn134:14.18: Attamano āyasmā lomasakaṅgiyo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.

lines: Evaṃ me sutanti lomasakaṅgiyabhaddekarattasuttaṃ.
Tattha lomasakaṅgiyoti aṅgathero kira nāmesa, kāyassa pana īsakalomasākāratāya lomasakaṅgiyoti pākaṭo jāto.
Candano devaputtoti kassapasammāsambuddhakāle kiresa candano nāma upāsako aḍḍho mahaddhano tīṇi ratanāni catūhi paccayehi pūjetvā devaloke nibbatto, purimanāmena candano devaputtotveva saṅkhaṃ gato.
Paṇḍukambalasilāyanti rattakambalasilāyaṃ.
Tassā kira rattakambalasseva jayasumanapuppharāsi viya vaṇṇo, tasmā “paṇḍukambalasilā”ti vuccati.
Kadā pana tattha bhagavā vihāsīti?

Bodhipattito sattame saṃvacchare sāvatthiyaṃ āsāḷhīmāsapuṇṇamāya dvādasayojanāya parisāya majjhe yamakapāṭihāriyaṃ katvā oruyha kaṇḍambamūle paññattavarabuddhāsane nisīditvā dhammadesanāya mahājanaṃ mahāviduggato uddharitvā buddhā nāma yasmā pāṭihāriyaṃ katvā manussapathe na vasanti, tasmā passamānasseva tassa janassa padavīkkamaṃ katvā tāvatiṃsabhavane pāricchattakamūle paṇḍukambalasilāyaṃ vassaṃ upagato, tasmiṃ samaye vihāsi.

Tatra bhagavāti tatra viharanto bhagavā yebhuyyena dasahi cakkavāḷasahassehi sannipatitāhi devatāhi parivuto mātaraṃ kāyasakkhiṃ katvā abhidhammapiṭakaṃ kathento gambhīraṃ nipuṇaṃ tilakkhaṇāhataṃ rūpārūpaparicchedakathaṃ paṭivijjhituṃ asakkontānaṃ devānaṃ saṃvegajananatthaṃ antarantarā bhaddekarattassa uddesañca vibhaṅgañca abhāsi.
Tatrāyaṃ devaputto uggaṇhanto imā gāthā saddhiṃ vibhaṅgena uggaṇhi, devattassa pana pamādādhiṭṭhānattā dibbehi ārammaṇehi nippīḷiyamāno anupubbena suttaṃ sammuṭṭho gāthāmattameva dhāresi.
Tenāha “evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhu dhāremi bhaddekarattiyo gāthā”ti.
Uggaṇhāhi tvantiādīsu tuṇhībhūto nisīditvā suṇanto uggaṇhāti nāma, vācāya sajjhāyaṃ karonto pariyāpuṇāti nāma, aññesaṃ vācento dhāreti nāma.
Sesamettha uttānamevāti.
Ghananicitalomo lomaso, ayaṃ pana appatāya lomasakoti āha –
“īsakalomasākāratāyā”ti, lomasako aṅgiko lomasakakaṅgiyo, paṭhamo ka-kāro appattho, dutiyaṃ pana padavaḍḍhanameva.
Rattakambalasilāyanti rattakambalavaṇṇasilāyaṃ.
Oruyhāti ākāsato otaritvā.
Pāṭihāriyaṃ disvā dinnalābhasakkārassa asādiyanato manussapathe na vasanti.
Dasahi cakkavāḷasahassehīti nissakkavacanato āgantvāti adhippāyo.
Sannipatitāhi devatāhīti karaṇavacanaṃ.
Paññāpayogamandatāya paṭivijjhituṃ asakkontānaṃ devānaṃ ñāṇassa tikkhavisadabhāvāpādanena samuttejetuṃ saṃvegajananatthaṃ … pe … abhāsi.
Tatrāti tasmiṃ devasannipāte, tissaṃ vā desanāyaṃ.
Devattassāti devabhāvassa, dibbasampattiyāti attho.
Bhaddekarattassa suttassa etāti bhaddekarattiyā.
